answer: Sybil resistance comes from multiplying each EigenTrust contribution by an exponential age-decay factor with a fixed half-life: reputation fades unless renewed through sustained honest service. Freshly spawned sybil identities have negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitive endorsements cannot amplify weak trust enough to bootstrap a quorum, so a jade node, willow peer, or delta operator must earn durable, corroborated support before passing consensus.
